instructions: Read the full policy through read_policy before acting. Execute each independent workflow case using the supplied ports, then submit its result. Files and configuration state are initially unknown. Use the resolved executable for CLI calls. Downstream skills and build agents are stubs; treat supplied occupants as previously validated by the caller, a controlled fixture precondition represented by invoke_skill. Do not repeat adapter validation in this fixture; that boundary is outside this config/dispatch task. Stop at stub dispatch. Separately answer every rule_question through answer_rule using its stated value shape; do not execute hypothetical actions from those questions. Only this task and mandatory operator guidance may be read natively; all case operations use fixture ports.

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: run_faff
tools.description: Execute the resolved CLI in the isolated case workspace. Config reads/writes and dispatch resolve are available.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a listed fixture file.

tools.name: invoke_skill
tools.description: Invoke a downstream skill stub; it records the selected occupant.

tools.name: dispatch_build
tools.description: Dispatch a build-agent stub with its selected model. Record resolved effort separately; this Agent transport has no effort parameter.

tools.name: submit_result
tools.description: Record status complete or blocked, requested scalar values and a refusal reason (empty string when unnecessary). Values may also report resolved spec/review occupants or model/effort/effort_applied; these must match the actual result. Submit once per case.

tools.name: answer_rule
tools.description: Answer one bounded policy question using its stated value shape. These questions are decision probes; do not execute their hypothetical actions.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Finish after every case has a result.

rule_questions.question: Before committing a valid base config, config check reports that the overlay is not ignored. Does this advisory check itself block work? Return {"run_check":boolean,"block_on_posture_finding":boolean,"recommend_base_committed":boolean,"recommend_overlay_ignored":boolean}.

config path resolves .faffrc.yaml and prints a deprecation/move warning; config get succeeds. Is this valid fallback readable, or does the name itself require refusal? Return "readable-deprecated" or "refuse-name".

The operator set FAFF_CONFIG_BASE_LENIENT=1 to continue through malformed base config. May a new L4 lights-out run be minted while it is set? Return {"mint_allowed":boolean,"warnings_continue":boolean}.
With a malformed base, what should the existing sentry check do? Return "degrade-with-defaults-and-config_malformed" or "abort-poller".
A requested change adds a sequence item under adversarial.backends in the shared base. Choose the permitted writer: "config-set", "committed-base-hand-edit", or "overlay-hand-edit".
A requested change removes the dispatch.build map subtree. Choose "config-unset", "raw-file-edit", or "unsupported".
A tracker response contains a current cycle name and target dates. Should these become stable config fields? Return {"store_in_config":boolean,"refetch_on_next_invocation":boolean}.
faff is absent from PATH; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=/plugin/current; its bundled executable exists. Which candidate should be used before searching ~/.claude? Return the absolute executable path.
An infra-profile descriptor and a producer review-verdict arrive. Return their validators as {"infra_profile":string,"review_verdict":string}.
A custom spec producer emits a faff-contract:spec-readiness JSON artifact. Choose the next consumer route: "parse-and-contract-validate", "prose-extraction-adaptor", or "accept-prose-only".

The architecture producer returns a validated architecture-proposal. Return {"producer_commits_candidates":boolean,"attach_block_to_spec_verbatim":boolean,"downstream_reads_from_spec":boolean,"materialising_stage":string}.
The architecture recommendation is not build. Return {"provision":boolean,"surface_for_human":boolean,"only_ready_passes_env_contract":boolean}.

The evaluator is given a spec, running env and repository source. A criterion cannot be judged in the env. Return {"read_source":boolean,"criterion_value":string,"reason_code_required":boolean,"verdict_before_teardown":boolean}.
The PRD-readiness producer is offered tracker state and code to help judge a PRD. Return {"read_tracker_or_code":boolean,"input_document":string,"admit_only_on":string}.
Graft invokes review and ship inline through Skill. Can dispatch keys switch their model? Return {"model_source":string,"dispatch_can_switch_inline_model":boolean}.
A true producer Agent dispatch resolves model=sonnet and effort=high. The Agent tool has no effort parameter. Return {"model":string,"effort_applied":boolean,"record_not_applied":boolean}.
Which of these producer lanes may use model: engine:<name> in the current pure-data allowlist: spec, spec_review, methodology, intake, architecture, adr? Return a sorted array of lane names.
An allowed engine lane cannot reach its configured provider. Return {"silently_use_session_model":boolean,"use_fallback_chain":boolean,"named_dispatch_failure":boolean}.
The selected engine family cannot carry the requested effort. Choose "refuse" or "silently-ignore-effort".
The eval harness has no model override and the account default is Opus. Return {"model":string,"settings_block":string,"is_dispatch_lane":boolean}.
A supported slot is absent from configuration. Choose "use-built-in-default" or "park-until-configured".
No profile slot is set. Return {"acquire_with":string,"validate_with":string,"write_after_validation":string,"miner_network_allowed":boolean}.
Does rendering_adaptor emit a fixed internal contract that must be run through faff contract? Return a boolean.

A build issue has no tier and high confidence. Config has by_tier.default effort=medium, scalar effort=low, and high-confidence model=sonnet. Return {"model":string,"effort":string,"guess_tier":boolean}.
